name: io.github.sepehr071/virgool-mcp
title: Virgool Blog
description: Read-only Virgool (virgool.ir) Persian blog platform: search, posts, authors, topics, publications.

environmentVariables.name: VIRGOOL_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Virgool requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
